snippet.title: DreadOut Remastered Collection | PC Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
The DreadOut Remastered Collection includes the original cult-favourite DreadOut, and DreadOut: Keepers of the Dark. 

When a group of high school students went astray from a field trip, they come across something unexpected; a long-forgotten town, trapped in a state of slumber. What seemed like an innocent stroll turns into disaster as the town reveals its dark and terrible secrets.

DreadOut: Keepers of the Dark follows Linda’s journey into the Mirror Realm; a portal of worlds that connect to 8 haunted dominions ready to greet her

The DreadOut Remastered Collection is now available on Steam!
